title: The ALFWorld JEPA learned expert transitions but was trained on mismatched counterfactual histories
decision: Invalidate the current ALFWorld GAR result, repair both causal-prefix paths, and add direct counterfactual state-latent prediction before retraining.
plain_summary: The model retrieves every executed training transition, but counterfactual dynamics remain near persistence and GAR fits labels constructed through a different causal interface from planning.
